document.abstract: A brief account is given of the development of the process projection art, and the difficulties that arose due to its intial haphazard evolution. Following this is an account of the work of the Process Projection Equipment Committee of the Research Council of the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences, leading up to the recommendations of the Committee with regard to the projection equipment used in the process.
